purpose: Use the external human-skull source as a reference/projection target for correcting humanoid head face plates before any join or watertight mesh pass.

external_skull_source.upstream_license_note: Vendor README records Open 3D Model / anatomytool.org source and CC BY-SA note. Keep provenance with any derived usage.

reference_alignment_policy.meaning: Scale the skull reference uniformly to each compiled head variant height, then center the skull bounds inside the variant bounds for comparison and overlay rendering.
limits: This is a reference overlay, not a shrinkwrap operation.
Landmarks are coarse skull-reference anchors until a real landmark extractor exists.
The skull is understructure; final stylized skin/face volume is still owned by the humanoid head taxonomy and compiler.

coarse_landmark_targets.conform_use: Check top and rear skull envelope scale.
Check rear cranium depth in side view.
Guide brow ridge height and eye socket placement.

coarse_landmark_targets.source: skull dimension bundle nasal bridge width
coarse_landmark_targets.conform_use: Guide nose bridge width and nose root placement.
Guide cheek plane width and side wrap.

coarse_landmark_targets.source: skull dimension bundle jaw width and jaw height
coarse_landmark_targets.conform_use: Guide jaw/chin side profile and lower-face weight.

quality_checks: skull source build report declares source_of_truth
skull source approval includes front and side views
compiled variants still pass numeric QC
every conform target part exists in every compiled variant
overlay renderer consumes compiled variant JSON and external GLTF only
